title: FrameAtom
description: One frame atom: the content-addressable vocabulary a values guard classifies a write against. Runtime-read S2 data (both governance hosts load it; no codegen projection). The atom names the validator ref it binds because a validator receives only the write, never its registry row's parameters. Lifecycle (status, contentHash, supersession) lives on the policy registry row that declares `frame:` / `frame-ref:`, never inside the atom; the atom's identity is the registry-row CID recipe over its canonical body. Source of truth: this schema.

id.description: Atom id; equals the filename stem.

validator.description: The governance-validators.json ref this atom supplies vocabulary to.

apex_concept.description: The concept whose assertion as the protocol's own apex value the frame detects.

family.description: A defeater frame: its presence defeats a claim of alignment unless a legitimate frame is declared.

cost_class.description: A false positive accuses a correct author; verdicts stay advisory and a keyword-silent semantic catch is abstain.

apex_answer.description: The rubric answer that names drift; every other answer is a legitimate frame id.

phrases.description: Lowercase apex phrases matched against the folded shadow of the write.

markers.description: In-content frame declarations; any one present marks the frame adjudicated for the surface.

min_net_new.description: Post-write hits must exceed prior hits by at least this many to fire (cleaning never fires).

scan_cap_bytes.description: Beyond this many bytes the fold is skipped: substring-only scan, `unscanned-tail` recorded.

cosine_floor.description: Semantic shadow-probe floor; a hit at or above it is recorded as abstain, never an accusation.

probe_min_net_new_bytes.description: Net-new bytes a keyword-silent write needs before the shadow probe runs.

cites.description: Repo-relative canon documents the frame's rubric answers to.
